errors.text_span: 水平轴标签包括“空间体积”，“事件”，“情形”，“方向”，“景点”，“相关”，“领域”，“事件性”，“路径”，以及“相关性”
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly translates or hallucinates most of the labels on the horizontal axis. For example, “空间体积” should be “空间实体”, “情形” should be “处所”, “景点” should be “原文时间”, and “相关性” is not a label in the chart. It also omits the majority of the labels.
The description fails to mention that the values on the vertical axis are percentages (%).
The stated range up to 31.94 is incorrect; the maximum value shown on any bar is 31.6%.
The description claims the vertical axis has a tick interval of 5, but there are no visible tick marks or labels on the y-axis.

errors.text_span: 紫色表示“验证集”以及橙色对应“测试集”
errors.evidence: The color mapping is incorrect. The legend shows that the '验证集' (validation set) is orange, and the '测试集' (test set) is gray, not purple and orange respectively.

errors.text_span: 例如，“空间体积”标签的“训练集”柱状图高度约为 21.78，而该标签的“测试集”柱状图高度约为 8.66。
errors.evidence: The category name is incorrect (it should be “空间实体”). More importantly, the values are completely wrong. The actual values for this category are 31.6% for the training set and 31.6% for the test set, not 21.78 and 8.66.

errors.text_span: “相关性”标签的“训练集”柱状图是最低的，高度约为 1.26
errors.evidence: This entire statement is fabricated. The label “相关性” does not exist on the chart. The lowest bars correspond to the “隐式距离” category, with the training set value being 0.1%, not 1.26.

errors.text_span: “事件”和“情形”标签的“训练集”柱状图都高度接近，分别为 19.75 和 19.59
errors.evidence: This statement contains multiple errors. The label “情形” is incorrect; it should be “处所”. The value for the “事件” training set is 22.1%, not 19.75. The value for the “处所” training set is 19.5%, not 19.59. The cited values are fabricated.
